header.choice: none: only ground-level Main Beach snaps (surfboard close-up; pandanus tree with people) exist; neither sells Byron Bay as a sweeping beach-and-cape view

candidates.reason: Aerial of the headland with the lighthouse on top, turquoise sea and long beach beyond; 3949x2962, Dec 2020. Shows the cape and lighthouse; aerial acceptable as the reason is the cape setting.
Low-angle lighthouse with crowd of visitors; people prominent, lighthouse only, no walk or cape setting; less wide.
Tilted horizon, lighthouse cut by sky; poor composition.
Wategos at sunrise: wet sand, surf and the wooded headland in backlight; 4032x3024, Dec 2020. Moody but recognisably a Byron beach; a different image from the Main Beach spot photo.
Aerial panorama 2.47:1; houses fill the headland and centre-crop to 1.6:1 loses the beach; aerial not warranted for a beaches reason.
